SELECT HOUSE_CODE ,TYPE ,CODE ,TEXT1 ,TEXT2 FROM (SELECT HOUSE_CODE , TYPE , CODE , TEXT1 , TEXT2 , RANK() OVER(ORDER BY CASE WHEN LANGUAGE = ${session.LANGUAGE} THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, LANGUAGE) RANK FROM SCODE WHERE TYPE = 'M000' AND ( UPPER( CODE ) LIKE CONCAT('%' , UPPER( $S{F_KEYWORD} ) , '%') OR UPPER( TEXT1 ) LIKE CONCAT('%' , UPPER( $S{F_KEYWORD} ) , '%') OR UPPER( TEXT2 ) LIKE CONCAT('%' , UPPER( $S{F_KEYWORD} ) , '%') OR UPPER( TEXT3 ) LIKE CONCAT('%' , UPPER( $S{F_KEYWORD} ) , '%') ) AND #DB_OWNER#NVL( DEL_FLAG, 'N' ) = 'N' AND HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE}
) AS CODE WHERE RANK = 1 ORDER BY CODE

SELECT HOUSE_CODE ,TYPE ,CODE ,TEXT1 ,TEXT2 ,FLAG FROM (SELECT HOUSE_CODE , TYPE , CODE , TEXT1 , TEXT2 , FLAG , RANK() OVER(ORDER BY CASE WHEN LANGUAGE = ${session.LANGUAGE} THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, LANGUAGE) RANK FROM SCODE WHERE TYPE = 'S000' AND ( UPPER( CODE ) LIKE CONCAT('%' , UPPER( $S{F_KEYWORD} ) , '%') OR UPPER( TEXT1 ) LIKE CONCAT('%' , UPPER( $S{F_KEYWORD} ) , '%') OR UPPER( TEXT2 ) LIKE CONCAT('%' , UPPER( $S{F_KEYWORD} ) , '%') OR UPPER( TEXT3 ) LIKE CONCAT('%' , UPPER( $S{F_KEYWORD} ) , '%') ) AND #DB_OWNER#NVL( DEL_FLAG, 'N' ) = 'N' AND HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE}
) AS CODE WHERE RANK = 1 ORDER BY CODE

SELECT CODE.TYPE AS MODULE_TYPE ,CODE.CODE AS TYPE ,CODE.CLIENT_CUSTOM_FLAG ,LANG.USE_FLAG ,LANG.FLAG ,LANG.TEXT1 AS TEXT1_#LANGUAGE# ,LANG.TEXT2 AS TEXT2_#LANGUAGE# ,LANG.TEXT3 AS TEXT3_#LANGUAGE# ,LANG.TEXT4 AS TEXT4_#LANGUAGE# ,LANG.TEXT5 AS TEXT5_#LANGUAGE# FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT HOUSE_CODE ,TYPE ,CODE ,CLIENT_CUSTOM_FLAG FROM SCODE WHERE TYPE = ${MODULE_TYPE} AND #DB_OWNER#NVL( DEL_FLAG, 'N' ) = 'N' AND HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND CODE = ${TYPE} AND LANGUAGE = ${LANGUAGE} ) CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN SCODE LANG ON CODE.HOUSE_CODE = LANG.HOUSE_CODE AND CODE.TYPE = LANG.TYPE AND CODE.CODE = LANG.CODE AND LANG.LANGUAGE = ${LANGUAGE}

SELECT CODE.TYPE ,CODE.CODE ,LANG.TEXT1 AS TEXT1_#LANGUAGE# ,LANG.TEXT2 AS TEXT2_#LANGUAGE# ,LANG.TEXT3 AS TEXT3_#LANGUAGE# ,LANG.TEXT4 AS TEXT4_#LANGUAGE# ,LANG.TEXT5 AS TEXT5_#LANGUAGE# ,LANG.TEXT6 AS TEXT6_#LANGUAGE# ,LANG.TEXT7 AS TEXT7_#LANGUAGE# ,LANG.SORT_SEQ AS SORT ,CASE WHEN LANG.USE_FLAG = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS USE_FLAG FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT HOUSE_CODE ,TYPE ,CODE FROM SCODE WHERE TYPE = ${TYPE} AND #DB_OWNER#NVL( DEL_FLAG, 'N' ) = 'N' AND HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} ) CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN SCODE LANG ON CODE.HOUSE_CODE = LANG.HOUSE_CODE AND CODE.TYPE = LANG.TYPE AND CODE.CODE = LANG.CODE AND LANG.LANGUAGE = ${LANGUAGE} ORDER BY SORT, CODE
